note: Jobs the cantina owner can offer (M12). Only real jobs: each one completes when something actually happens in the game (completes_on is a WorldState trigger). requires uses the same conditions as rumors. requires.story = the story chapter reached (Story.reached).

jobs.title: Droids for the general
jobs.text: General Vask wants assassin droids from the desert, fixed up or bought, and pays three times what the droid merchant does. Hand them over to him at the barracks.
jobs.note: Issues #203, #204: the general's repeating job (giver: only his brain offers it). Not while Remnant standing is hostile (-50 and below). Each droid handed over pays and raises standing, and the job is open again (GeneralPost.hand_over).

jobs.title: Thin the orbital patrol
jobs.text: The locals pool 200 credits for anyone who breaks the Remnant patrol in orbit. Your ship is in the pit; the pad is the button.

jobs.title: The range bet
jobs.text: Knock all five practice targets flat in under twenty seconds. The pot is 40 credits and some pride.

jobs.title: A drop for the fence
jobs.text: Somebody left %s %s. Get it to the fence in the market, and keep it away from the Remnant at the front gate.

goods.say_one: a crate of space whale teeth

jobs.note: Repeats forever: Oda lines up the next drop once the last one is picked up and the player carries no contraband. Pays is what the fence gives for the goods; the fence pays it, not Oda. Issue #64: opens with the story's first smuggling run (Story chapter smuggle_1).

jobs.title: A drop for the station merchant
jobs.text: Somebody left %s %s on the rock outside. Get it to the merchant in front of the cantina.

goods.say_one: a crate of space whale teeth

jobs.note: Repeats forever on the asteroid: the drop lands on the rock outside the sealed station, and the merchant in front of the cantina buys it. No story requirement; it belongs to grit_station_town only.

jobs.title: A price on a Remnant officer
jobs.note: Issue #64: repeats forever once the story reaches the bounty. The text is filled in from WorldState.bounty (the officer's name, their crime, the outpost, the pay); taking it puts the officer at that outpost; the fence pays when they are dead. Pays is the bounty.
